chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allah al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who forgot to say the takbir until he had entered into the salat (prayer). He said: “Was it not his intention to say the takbir?” I said: “Yes.” He said: “Then let him continue in his salat (prayer).”

key_terms.نِيَّتِهِ: his intention to perform the act

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets Takbīrat al-Iftitāḥ after entering the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the opening takbir after entering the salat (prayer). If he had intended to pronounce the takbir, he should continue his prayer and not break it on account of that forgetfulness.
